summary: Akzo Nobel N.V. furnished a Form -6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that it will hold an Extraordinary General Meeting on November 30, 2026 to vote on proposals tied to its previously announced all-share merger of equals with Axalta Coating Systems Ltd. Agenda items include amending the articles to adopt the combined company name Axanzo N.V. (tickers AXZ on Euronext Amsterdam and NYSE) and appointing Denise Johnson, Stephan Tanda and Robert Schuchna as non-executive directors. No price, exchange ratio or premium is stated. Watch for shareholder approval timing, regulatory clearances and the closing calendar.
